items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Shelley and I did a trio date with him, just piano, bass and drums.

ctx.x: Well, on Decca, Shelley and I did a trio date with him, just piano, bass and drums. And Carmen Cavallero was I guess you'd say a perfectionist. We did actually 46 whole takes on a tune because there was some little run that he wasn't quite satisfied with. I don't think you'll find that in the discographies anywhere, but that was another thing that Shelley and I...I shouldn't say "suffered through," but it did get difficult -- to do 46 complete takes on one tune.
I guess! Then your other film that is listed is St. Louis Blues in 1958.
